map.基础体温（BBT）是指人体在完全休息状态下的体温，通常在早晨醒来后、未进行任何活: Basal body temperature (BBT) is the body temperature in a fully rested state, usually measured right after waking in the morning before any activity.

map.4. 将每日体温记录在表格上，连接成曲线: 4. Record daily temperature on a chart and connect into a curve
map.排卵前体温较低（36.2-36.5℃左右，排卵后体温升高0.3-0.5℃，持续1: Temperature is lower before ovulation (about 36.2-36.5°C); after ovulation it rises 0.3-0.5°C and lasts 12-14 days
map.体温最低点的前一天就是排卵日，体温升高后进入黄体期: The day before the lowest point is the ovulation day; after the rise enters the luteal phase
map.双相型体温提示有排卵，单相型提示无排卵: Biphasic temperature suggests ovulation; monophasic suggests anovulation
map.排卵试纸通过检测尿液中黄体生成素（LH）的峰值水平，预测排卵时间。LH峰值出现后: Ovulation strips predict ovulation by detecting the peak of luteinizing hormone (LH) in urine. Ovulation occurs 24-48 hours after the LH peak.
map.1. 从月经第10-12天开始每天检测: 1. Start daily testing from day 10-12 of the period
map.3. 检测前2小时减少饮水，避免尿液稀释: 3. Reduce water 2 hours before testing to avoid diluting urine
map.4. 将试纸浸入尿液中3-5秒，平放10-15分钟观察结果: 4. Dip the strip in urine for 3-5 seconds, lay flat 10-15 minutes to read
map.检测线颜色等于或深于对照线，提示24-48小时内排卵: Test line equal to or darker than the control line, suggests ovulation in 24-48 hours
map.检测线浅于对照线，未到排卵峰值: Test line lighter than the control line, not yet at LH peak

map.Input: 月经周期 28 天、经期 5 天（以末次月经第 1 天为基准）。\:
Input: menstrual cycle 28 days, period 5 days (based on day 1 of last period). 
 Ovulation day ≈ cycle day (28−14) = 14; fertile window = 5 days before to 1 day after ovulation ≈ days 9-15; next period ≈ day 28. 
 Period ≈ days 1-5. 
 Conclusion: for this 28-day cycler, the fertile window is about days 9-15; to conceive, have intercourse every other day from day 9; the calendar safe-period method has a high failure rate and is not recommended alone for contraception.

map.不可靠。排卵受情绪、疾病、压力影响可提前或推后，精子体内可存活 5 天，故「安全: Not reliable. Ovulation can shift earlier or later with mood, illness and stress, and sperm can survive 5 days in the body, so the 'safe period' is not truly safe, with an annual failure rate over 20%. Effective contraception should use condoms or short-acting pills; this tool is only for cycle education.
